convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Fractal_WPR which is a non-standard custom indicator with fractal dimension calculation; external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution and lot sizing with complex margin-based position sizing logic

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position: long signal triggers SELL_Close, short signal triggers BUY_Close; BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags control whether signal-based closes are allowed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM<0: use absolute value of MM as fixed lot; if MM>=0 and MMMode=LOT(4): use absolute value of MM as fixed lot; if MM>=0 and MMMode=FREEMARGIN(0): lot=freemargin*MM/margin_per_lot; if MM>=0 and MMMode=BALANCE(1): lot=balance*MM/margin_per_lot; if MM>=0 and MMMode=LOSSFREEMARGIN(2): lot=(freemargin*MM)/|loss_at_SL_per_lot|; if MM>=0 and MMMode=LOSSBALANCE(3): lot=(balance*MM)/|loss_at_SL_per_lot|

custom_logic_notes: TrendMode(DIRECT/AGAINST) reverses signal interpretation: in AGAINST mode, WPR crossing below -70 generates a SELL signal instead of BUY, and crossing above -30 generates a BUY signal instead of SELL. TimeLevel mechanism prevents re-entry until the next bar's open time after a trade is placed (global variable guard). StopCorrect adjusts SL/TP to broker minimum stop level if too close. LotFreeMarginCorrect reduces lot size if insufficient free margin. Signal is read from SignalBar index (default=1, previous completed bar) with 2-buffer copy for crossover detection.
python_conversion_notes: The Fractal_WPR custom indicator requires full reimplementation: it computes fractal dimension index (FDI) from normalized price series, derives Hurst exponent, then adaptively scales the WPR period. The WPR calculation itself is non-standard (uses custom price series with 12 price types including TrendFollow and Demark). Position sizing has 5 modes with conditional logic (negative=fixed lot). The TimeLevel global variable mechanism prevents re-entry until next bar. SL/TP are in points (not pips) with no 5-digit adjustment — StopCorrect only enforces broker minimum stop distance. Must implement FDI calculation precisely: length=sum(sqrt((diff[i]-diff[i-1])^2 + 1/period^2)), fdi=1+(log(length)+log(2))/log(2*(period-1)). WPR is then calculated with adaptive speed=round(normal_speed*beta) where beta=1/(2*(2-fdi)). TrendMode AGAINST reverses signal-to-direction mapping.
